newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

Spokesman Thierry Daman announced a news conference at 1500/1300 GMT on Tuesday by DGX, Youth Forum and Young European Federalists representatives on an Internet inter-governmental conference simulation.
Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said Wednesday's Commission midday briefing would start at 1115/0915 GMT instead of 1200/1000 GMT.

Van der Pas said Commissioner Mario Monti would hold a news conference on Wednesday at 1130/0930 GMT on the action plans for transit in Europe and for the single market. He said Commissioner Liikanen would follow at 1200/1000 to present reporters the draft budget for 1998.

Van der Pas also announced news conferences by Commissioner Emma Bonino at 1230/1030 GMT on control and scientific consultation in food safety and by Commissioners Martin Bangemann and Franz Fischler at 1300/1100 GMT on a green paper on food legislation.
In answer to a question, spokesman Gerry Kiely said there was nothing new on the EU/U.S. food safety negotiations.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/362: Single market: overview of compliance problems in 1996.
- IP/97/363: The Commission authorises the acquisition by Hoogovens Group of 50 percent of Usines Gustave Boel.
- IP/97/364: The Commission authorises the creation of Champion Profil joint venture between ProfilArbed and Etablissements Metallurgiques J Champion SA.
- Speech/97/102: Speech by Commissioner Yves-Thibault de Silguy on "the impact of the creation of the euro on financial markets and international monetary system".
- Speech/97/103: Closing address by Commissioner Padraig Flynn at the European Forum on the future of the social dialogue.
- Eurostat news release No 32/97: New high for interest payments on government debt.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Economy and finance No 1997-4: Interest payments and government expenditure in the EU.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Agriculture, forestry and fisheries No 1997-6: Economic accounts for agriculture and forestry; detailed 1995 data released.
- Commission meeting provisional agenda for Wednesday April 30, 1997.
